description: Uploads a snapshot package file to a Cognigy.AI project. Use this to restore a previously downloaded snapshot or transfer a snapshot between environments. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to upload. Async operation.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates the file exists without uploading. Set to false to actually upload.

filePath.description: Local file path to the snapshot package file (e.g., './snapshot.csnap' or 'C:/snapshots/backup.csnap')

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 3)

projectId.description: The target project ID to upload the snapshot package to

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for upload and processing (5-600 seconds, default 180)

name: upload_snapshot_package
